subject: Judge: review Codex + Cursor local-CLI providers
description: Single-attempt code review (self-learn-judge review mode) of the Codex+Cursor providers attempt. get_attempt_diff, then rubric: (1) both providers are kind 'agentic-cli', registered, and mirror the Claude provider interface (resolveBin/isAvailable/isAuthed/buildInvocation/parseResult); (2) buildInvocation produces a plausible headless invocation for each CLI (non-interactive, output streaming, model, skip-confirmation) — sanity-check flags against each CLI's documented headless mode; (3) isAvailable/isAuthed gate correctly (bin presence / auth/config), and a not-installed CLI yields isAvailable=false without throwing; (4) getActiveBackend selects each by overlay.config.backend.provider; (5) cross-platform bin resolution (Windows .cmd/.exe); (6) tests mock the bins + assert argv/gating/parse; scope = providers only (no dashboard/api/drain changes). Under the feature, APPROVE → merge_attempt (attempt→feature, auto-abort on conflict); KICK BACK → set_status failed + record_decision wired to the impl. NEVER force-merge.
